children: surged 13.2% in Friday's trading as Stifel initiated coverage with a Buy rating and $25 price target, saying the company is set to become the Western leader in tungsten production by year-end 2028, while tungsten prices have soared 775% since the start of 2025 as China's export controls have structurally changed the market.

China's restrictions on tungsten exports have resulted in a structural shift in the global market and created a significant gap between supply and demand that will keep prices elevated over the near-to-medium term, Stifel analysts Brock Cannon and Jon Seigmann said.
